description: Bounded .h2ochat export capability. Grants only the minimum Desktop filesystem access needed to stage one verified saved-chat package under $HOME/H2O Studio Exports. Final folder and ZIP publication use purpose-bounded native atomic create-only commands, so renderer-side rename authority is not granted. No arbitrary user-selected paths, no $HOME/** write scope, no $DOWNLOAD/** write scope, no archive package mutation, no sync/WebDAV/cloud integration, and no Chrome authority.
